projects.title: Prismet / Kaleidoscope
projects.summary: A native Apple playground where games, daily rituals, and useful data lenses share one shifting home.
projects.history: Chess Hotswap began as the archived origin of Kaleidoscope, built to hot-swap between 2D and 3D chess.

shots.alt: Kaleidoscope home screen on iPhone: a Daily section with Wordgame, then puzzle tiles for 2048, Snake, Minesweeper, and Sudoku.
The 2D chess board inside Kaleidoscope, mid-game on iPhone.
Kaleidoscope's Sea Battle grid on iPhone.
Solitaire laid out in Kaleidoscope on iPhone.
The 3D Catan board in its meadow theme, rendered in Kaleidoscope.

projects.title: The Long Now
projects.summary: An evolving desktop game world where courts, campaigns, and small human decisions accumulate over time.

shots.alt: The medieval era of The Long Now: a pixel-art river crossing with tents, a campfire, and a stone keep in the trees.
The same world dressed for its industrial era.
The far-future Dyson era of the world's dressing pass.

projects.title: PrismCode
projects.summary: A Mac-native coding workspace exploring a calmer relationship between projects, terminals, and AI collaborators.

shots.alt: PrismCode's Mission Control on a fresh launch, offering to add a DeepSeek, Claude, or Codex pane, with a file sidebar and a prompt bar across the bottom.

projects.title: Steam Rewind
projects.summary: A playful set of lenses that turns a sprawling Steam library into stories about time, value, and unfinished adventures.

shots.alt: Steam Rewind's most-played lens over the demo fixture, listing games with hours played, price, and Deck time.
The same library re-sorted by the cost-per-hour lens.

projects.title: Accessible Debt Clock
projects.summary: A calm, screen-reader-friendly view of the U.S. national debt using current Treasury data.

shots.alt: The debt clock showing the gross U.S. national debt in large green figures, with a spoken-value button, a pause-motion button, and per-citizen and per-taxpayer cards below.

projects.title: Cicero
projects.summary: A desktop council app with a native iPhone companion for the Forum, Historian, and a consensus-gated inbox.

shots.alt: Cicero's council floor: a Legion panel, a running transcript of the Curia, an All-Hands fleet panel, and a long verdict under the heading Cicero Speaks.

projects.title: Helix Research Desk
projects.summary: A local-first desktop workbench for transparent genetics research.

projects.title: AxiomEXTD
projects.summary: A Minecraft extension experiment that preserves Conquest block states and improves rotated Smart Paste.

shots.alt: A detailed Minecraft build on the server this extension targets: a dark spire above the clouds, ringed by towers and terraced ground.

projects.title: QR Scanner
projects.summary: A tiny browser QR scanner using camera APIs and native BarcodeDetector, with a bundled fallback.

shots.alt: The QR scanner before camera access: a start button, a camera picker, the framing reticle, and a field where decoded text appears.

projects.title: Screen Protection
projects.summary: A desktop privacy concept for hiding sensitive content when macOS screen recording is active.

projects.title: Escape Revert
projects.summary: A Mac utility that turns three rapid Escape presses into Cmd+[ to recover from wrong screens and loading states.

projects.title: HOI4 AI War Room
projects.summary: A local Mac cockpit combining a live game stream with a control and standings board.

shots.alt: The Hearts of Iron IV map the war room streams, showing central Europe in March 1936 with division counters and theatre panels.
The same game in 1940 with the observer console open in the corner, logging the AI agents' turns.

projects.title: Civilization V Mod Profiles
projects.summary: A Mac launcher workflow for moving between distinct Civilization V mod setups with less friction.

shots.alt: The launcher's Choose Your Build window: a green Stable Build card and a red Risky Build card, each listing the mods in its stack.

projects.title: Yggdrasil
projects.summary: A project to unify the FromSoft catalog inside one Elden Ring instance, starting with a Dark Souls III port.

projects.title: WoW Sidepanel
projects.summary: A World of Warcraft addon that reserves a partial right-side UI strip for multi-monitor layouts.

shots.alt: World of Warcraft filling an ultrawide display, with the character roster held in the narrow right-hand strip the addon reserves.

projects.title: Usage Tracker
projects.summary: An always-on local dashboard for agent-session usage, daily account totals, and estimated equivalent costs.

shots.alt: The usage dashboard: token totals per provider and account, a weekly limit meter, and a seven-day combined chart with estimated API-equivalent costs.

projects.title: Helm
projects.summary: A native iPhone master remote for home services, lifecycle controls, backups, consoles, and quick actions.

shots.alt: Helm's Mesh tab on iPhone, listing hosts and Minecraft servers with live status dots, resource use, and a tap-to-wake action.
Helm's PlexSquish tab, showing the media optimizer's queue and progress.
Helm's Misc tab of quick actions.

projects.title: PlexSquish
projects.summary: A Mac and Windows media optimizer with scanning, HEVC conversion, verification, atomic replacement, and live progress.

projects.title: Airhorn
projects.summary: A deliberately simple offline desktop app: one large button and an attributed air-horn recording.

shots.alt: The whole app: the word AIRHORN over one big red button, and a line noting you can press Space instead.

projects.title: Bayzyl
projects.summary: An in-game building toolkit for Paper servers with selections, brushes, shapes, shared kits, and builder profiles.

shots.alt: A cherry-blossom village built on the Paper server this toolkit runs on, lit up at night.
Another build from the same server, seen from above the cloud layer.
